WEBHOOK.description: Setting this to ANYTHING will enable webhooks when in env mode

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your bot token, as a string.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string (for example, your Neon database URL).

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Your private log channel ID where the bot has admin permissions.

OWNER_ID.description: Required: your numeric Telegram user ID. Only this user can interact with the bot.

ADMIN.description: Optional list of administrator user IDs.

BANNED_USERS.description: Optional list of user IDs blocked from using the bot.
